h3. Stage 5 - Test generation and QA (EPMCDMETST-69392)
Branch: feature/EPMCDMETST-69392-meetingnotes. Full report: artifacts/test-reports/test-execution-report-EPMCDMETST-69392.md

*Executed:* backend unit tests (Jest, no DB) - 7 suites, 109 / 109 passed (28 + 11 new tests for random doctor/slot assignment, race retry, error mapping, reschedule linking, SMS failedAfterRetries).
*Written but NOT executed:* backend integration tests (concurrency, errors, reschedule + SMS: 41 test definitions) - no PostgreSQL available; Playwright UI specs (33 test definitions, API stubbed) - Playwright not installed. No pass/fail result is claimed for these.
*BDD:* 4 feature files, 50 scenarios tagged by AC-1..AC-9 (specification only).

*Open findings:*
* UI: "Any doctor" without "Any available slot" posts an empty slotTime and the API returns 422 (Playwright test.fixme).
* Backend: a CANCELLED appointment can still be rescheduled (no status check) - needs a product decision.
* Backend: invalid slot returns INVALID_DATE on field appointmentDate instead of slotTime.
* Sunday check uses UTC day-of-week (tech design open question 1).

*Next step:* start Postgres and run npm run test:integration in backend; npm install in frontend/e2e and run npm run test:e2e.
